rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; P2+P4 are Pulp-only dependency carves. P2 moves GraphEditorView into pulp-view-graph-editor (core/view/audio) with its public include path preserved, removes the host-to-view-core edge, and keeps the view umbrellas free of the host stack. P4 moves the audio-dependent view widgets into pulp-view-audio, which links audio/signal/midi but never host, and which both view umbrellas link, so pulp-view-core links no audio/signal target. The Doxygen header-parity authority and SDK target lists follow both moves. No Vellum implementation or authority moves.
